source_binding_implementation: 3d16532f7 introduces src/adapter/mod_ppa_irrigation_source_binding.f90. It consumes previous physical forcing and successful SSDI process flux, copies unrelated forcing fields, replaces the SSDI rates and marks only a changed source or an existing event at the exact interval start. The owner integration test uses this binding for source start/continuation/stop instead of hand-setting event flags.
